name: Boundary Relaxation for Differentiable SDF Rendering
definition: A method for differentiable rendering of Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) that addresses non-differentiable visibility discontinuities by relaxing the sharp visibility boundary B into a thin band A. This allows accurate gradient computation with respect to scene parameters while retaining surface representations for forward rendering, avoiding the high variance of area sampling or the complexity of boundary sampling data structures.
summary: Boundary Relaxation is a differentiable SDF rendering method that replaces sharp visibility discontinuities with a thin band to enable accurate gradient computation while retaining surface representations and avoiding complex data structures.
